translation_notes: Each SELECT ... OPTIONAL ... FILTER(!bound(...)) query becomes s{ }: m{ } has no OPTIONAL/FILTER, so this is the only fit.

RML_* names are plain Python strings holding IRIs (not URIRef), so bare {RML_X} interpolation in term position coerces to a Literal and silently matches nothing; each use is wrapped {rdflib.term.URIRef(RML_X)} to keep the predicate an IRI, exactly the coercion trap in INSTRUCTIONS.md 2 bis.

@graph mapping_graph must NOT be followed by a trailing '.' inside a function body: with the dot, the transpiler mis-balances the braces of every s{ } that follows and raises a plain SyntaxError -- confirmed by a minimal repro; worth reporting upstream as a lexer/oracle gap.
Context shim rml_constants.py reconstructs the RML_* IRI constants from morph_kgc/constants.py at the pinned commit (not in the extracted context lines).
The .add() calls stay one per loop body (six independent loops): no join is introduced, so cardinality matches the original exactly.

repair.driver: le graphe du pilote reçoit, pour chaque règle, un voisin qui a déjà un termType (tm2b blank node, tm3b littéral, om4b object map à reference) ; trois object maps portant seulement execution, languageMap ou datatypeMap (aucune reference) ; un predicateMap et un graphMap sans termType (x6) ; la docstring de driver.py dit ce que chaque ajout exerce.
